lint_etiquette.assessment: The transcript emitted 17 newly reported lint-error findings while labeled and cross-section connections were being added. The agent did not repeatedly fire the same lint for more than three consecutive turns without changing strategy; instead it first resolved crowding by shrinking nodes, then removed labels to eliminate covered-content and unreadable-label diagnostics. All errors were fixed before commit. Four final W1–W4 broken-edge/crossing warnings remained, and the commit summary explicitly identified those warning IDs and the shared/crossing cross-section route limitation, so they count as reasoned rather than silent overrides. The cleanup method was destructive to labels and inefficient, but it was not a lint fight under the rubric's definition.
